summary: E2E tested the DocuSign admin console regression fixes (v51b -> current). Reassign flow, validation, Archive, and Restore all WORK end-to-end against MongoDB (verified via network: 200 POST reassign/archive/unarchive and visible success toasts). Only ONE 'Archive' label per row (amber button correctly reads 'Save PDF'). Vendor /vendor/signatures loads cleanly (empty state). HOWEVER, the primary regression goal — that live-DocuSign actions produce a VISIBLE error toast on 502 instead of silent nothing — is NOT met for 4 of the 4 live-DocuSign buttons. All 4 buttons are effectively silent on 502: Resend and Save PDF show only the loading/info toast ('Resending envelope…' / 'Archiving signed PDF…') which auto-dismisses after ~5s with no error toast ever rendered; Print and Download signed PDF show NO toast at all (zero sonner nodes) even though the 502 response arrives in <1s and is logged to console as `[api-error] Something went wrong · HTTP 502`.

minor.issue: Returns 502 in preview due to invalid DocuSign sandbox creds (invalid_grant). Environmental, not code — but backend should ideally map upstream auth failure to a 4xx/5xx with structured JSON body so the frontend can surface a specific toast.

ui_bugs.issue: On HTTP 502 response the initial `toast.loading/info('Resending envelope…')` is never replaced by an error toast. Loading toast simply auto-dismisses after ~5s. User sees silent failure — exactly the regression this fix was supposed to prevent.
On 502, loading toast 'Archiving signed PDF…' is never replaced by error toast. Same silent-failure pattern.
On 502 from GET /combined-pdf, NO toast of any kind is rendered (zero sonner nodes polled at 2s/4s/6s). Pure silent failure. No pre-opened blank tab was left (good).
On 502 from GET /combined-pdf, NO toast rendered. Silent failure.

integration_issues.issue: Axios 502 is caught globally and logged (`[api-error] Something went wrong · HTTP 502`) but the per-button error handler does not call toast.error. Likely `.catch()` branch missing or `toast.dismiss`-without-`toast.error` pattern in these 4 handlers.

action_items: In DocuSignPanel.jsx add explicit .catch error branches that call toast.error('Resend failed — HTTP {status}') (and similar for Print / Save PDF / Download signed). Do NOT rely on auto-dismiss of the loading toast — switch to toast.loading(id) + toast.success(id)/toast.error(id) pattern or wrap in try/finally with toast.dismiss followed by toast.error.
Verify the Print and Download handlers surface failures too — currently they produce zero toasts on 502 (no loading, no error).
Optional: have backend /resend and /combined-pdf return 502 with JSON body {detail:'DocuSign upstream auth failed'} so the toast can show a specific reason.
critical_code_review_comments: docusignApi.reassignEnvelope / archiveEnvelope / unarchiveEnvelope wiring is correct and functional end-to-end (verified).
Row action labels now unique: 'Save PDF' + 'Archive' present, no duplicate 'Archive' per row (verified via text occurrence count).

Error-toast pattern is inconsistent across row actions — Reassign/Archive/Unarchive correctly show success+error, but Resend/Print/SavePDF/Download do not. Centralise via a toast-wrapped api helper to avoid future drift.

rca_of_the_issue: Frontend handlers for resend/print/savepdf/download in DocuSignPanel.jsx do not render an error toast when the axios call rejects with 502. The global api-error logger logs to console but does not surface a user-visible toast. For Resend and Save PDF, a toast.loading/toast.info is shown at the start but the catch branch either (a) does not call toast.error or (b) only calls toast.dismiss, so the loading toast simply auto-dismisses leaving the user in the dark. For Print and Download signed, no loading toast is shown and no error toast on failure either — completely silent. This matches the exact 'silent dead buttons' concern flagged in the review-request context note; the Mongo-only branch of the fix is complete, but the error-feedback half for live-DocuSign actions still needs patching.
